portal.helpBody: Call us at (800) 555-0142 or email help@landgrantiq.com. We're here Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
portal.disclaimer: This portal gives you information about your property. It is not legal advice. You have the right to talk to your own lawyer at any time.

welcome.title: Welcome to your property portal
welcome.body: A company wants to use part of your land for a public project. This portal explains what is happening, shows you the offer, and lets you respond. Take your time. Nothing happens until you decide.
welcome.reassure: Your attorney reviews every step. You are not alone in this.

property.title: Your property
property.intro: Here is the property we are talking about.
property.none: We could not find a property linked to your account yet. Please contact us and we will help.

documents.title: Documents to review
documents.intro: These are the documents shared with you. Each one has a short, plain-language summary written for you.
documents.none: No documents have been shared yet. We will let you know when there are documents to review.

offer.title: The offer
offer.intro: This is what the company is offering for the use of your land.
offer.none: There is no offer to review yet. We will notify you when one is ready.

decision.title: Your decision
decision.intro: Choose what you would like to do. You can ask questions before deciding anything is final. Your attorney reviews your choice.
decision.acceptHint: You agree to the offer as written.
decision.question: Ask a question
decision.questionHint: Talk to your agent or attorney before deciding.
decision.declineHint: You do not accept the offer right now.
decision.confirmTitle: Thank you. We received your response.
decision.confirmBody: Your confirmation number is below. Keep it for your records. A member of our team will follow up with you.
decision.whatNext: What happens next: your response goes to your agent and attorney for review. We will contact you with the next steps.
decision.error: We could not send your response. Please try again, or call us for help.

common.selectParcelHint: Select a parcel from the list or map below to open its tools (comms, packet, rules, title, appraisal, ROE, and offers).
common.tasksParcelHint: Showing tasks for the whole project. Select a parcel to focus on its tasks.
common.litigationParcelHint: Select a parcel to file or manage its litigation case.

workbench.title: Workbench
workbench.subtitle: Review parcels on the map, manage the pre-offer packet, run jurisdiction rules, and advance each parcel through title, appraisal, ROE, and offers.

counsel.title: Counsel workbench
counsel.subtitle: Approve templates before filing, assemble the document binder, track litigation deadlines, and manage budgets — every action audit-logged.

ops.title: Route Planning & Communications
ops.subtitle: Field operations support: optimized visit routes, batch notifications, and live integration diagnostics.

admin.title: Admin Dashboard
admin.subtitle: System-wide view of all cases, projects, and services. Search across all data and monitor platform health.

firmAdmin.title: Firm Dashboard
firmAdmin.subtitle: Rolled-up view of all cases across your firm's projects. Monitor progress, track litigation, and review activity.
